messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled catalog enable for model azurewing-7b-v1 at 2026-05-12T23:00:00Z. Change window: 60m. Trigger: enable-catalog/azurewing. Initiated by Alex P.

Alex P: Quick check — fallback ordering set? We should prefer quant-7b-fast then quant-7b-safe then 6b-legacy.

Maya R: I updated the pinlist earlier, but the fallback ladder in runtime currently has different ordering. Confirming what runtime will see.

Jesse L: Runtime uses priority map key 'model_priority_v2'. Current snapshot: [azurewing-7b-v1, azurewing-7b-quant, pegasus-6b-legacy] — that's wrong.

Alex P: Need to match to this explicit ladder:
```
1. azurewing-7b-v1
2. azurewing-7b-quant-fast
3. azurewing-7b-quant-safe
4. pegasus-6b-legacy
```
Pinned versions: azurewing-7b-v1@20260511-1
Rollbacks: auto-roll back if error rate > 3% or p95 latency > 1.2s for 5m.

Samira K: Can we do a small canary first? 5% traffic for 30m then 25% for 20m? We should drain back if quality evals drop.

Oncall SRE: I'll be oncall for the cutover window. If we trigger rollback please @here and open incident channel #inc-azurewing.

Maya R: Deploy step already includes canary gating. Deploy-bot will set route weights: 5->25->100. I pushed updated catalog config to deploy branch: `catalog/azurewing/enable-20260512.yaml`

Jesse L: Also added tests for fallback order in flakey-network mode. See snippet:
```
assert order == ['azurewing-7b-v1','azurewing-7b-quant-fast','azurewing-7b-quant-safe','pegasus-6b-legacy']
```

ProductDocsBot: Draft release note created: 'Azurewing 7B: improved instruction-following and latency profile. Rolling enable 12 May 23:00 UTC. See docs link: https://redwood.ai/docs/releases/azurewing-7b'

Alex P: Final checks: confirm metric alerts hooked to new model routes (cost and token counters), and that realtime eval set 'azw_smoke_100' in Optimize is loaded.

Samira K: Cost alarms in place. Optimize has eval loaded. I also added a soft cap to prevent >40 RPS per ded-queue during canary.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: weight=5% -> targets: canary-pool-us-east, canary-pool-eu-west. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/azurewing-2567890123

Maya R: Observability note — enable logging of prompt hash to trace regressions. Added temporary trace hook.

Oncall SRE: Monitoring p95 and error-rate. Ready to abort if thresholds breached. @Alex P you own forced rollback decision.

Alex P: Agreed. If we see error_rate > 3% OR quality-drop > 4 points from baseline -> rollback. Otherwise proceed at 25m.

Jesse L: If rollback, run pinned command: `redwood catalog pin azurewing-7b-v1 --rollback-to previous` and check evictions.

Samira K: Good luck :rocket:
